_comment: Configuration file for AMIP simulations with covariance matrix. See script for details and defaults
process_comment: Data already been processed so don't reprocess
cov_file_comment: Path for covariance file. If null then use default value
location_file_comment: Path for location file. If null then use default value
standard_time_comment: Start & end time as ISO std string or null for no start or end.
variables_comment: List of variables to use. If empty use all available.
regions_comment: Std List of regions to process.
special_regions_comment: Special regions for specific variables. If a region is not listed here it will use the default regions.
scales_comment: Scaling factors for specific variables. If a variable is not listed here it will not be scaled. Needed for matrix regularisation. Precip-> mm/day, AOD -> x100, Reff -> microns, MSLP_DGM -> hPa, CLDliq -> percent, CTP -> hPa
